ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONAGREEMENT ASof m THIS ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION AGREEMENT, datedNovember , 2022, is between Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, an educationaf institution chartered by the New York State Board of Regenis,having an office c/o Mount Sinai Real Estate, 150 East 42nd Street, 2nd Floor, New York, New York 10017 ("Assignor"), and The Mount Sinai Hospital, a New York not-for-profit hospital corporation, having an office c/o Mount Sinai Real Estate, 150 East 42nd Street, 2nd Floor,New York,New York 10017 ("Assignee"). WITNESSETH. WHEREAS, Assignor holds all of the tenant's right, title and interest in, to and under the Lease,dated as of July17,2017,as amended by a First Amendment toLease,dated October 20,2020, and a Second Amendment of Lease, dated October 31,2022(collectively, the “Lease"), covering the entire Premises located at 158 West 124th Street, New York, New York (Block 1908, Lot 60) and the Building to be constructed thereon, all as more particularly described on Schedule A attached hereto and in the Lease; WHEREAS,a Memorandum of Lease,dated October 31,2022, reflecting the above has been recorded prior to the delivery of this agreement; and WHEREAS, Assignor desires to assign to Assignee its entire interest as tenant under the Lease, and Assignee desires to accept such assignment on the terms and conditions hereinafter setforth. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the sum of TEN ($10.00) DOLLARS paid by Assignee to Assignor and for other good and valuable consideration, the mutual receipt and legal sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Definitions. Capitalized terms used and not defined herein shall have the respective meanings ascribed thereto in the Lease. 2. Assignment. Assignor hereby assigns, sets over and transfers to Assignee all the Assignor's right, title and interest in, to and under the Lease, effective as of October 31, 2022 (the “Effective Date'), including, without limitation, all right, title and interest of Assignor in and to the Premises as tenant under the Lease and any renewal right contained in the Lease, if any, to have and to hold for the term of the Lease and any extensions or renewals thereof, subject to the termis and conditions set forth therein. 3. Assumption. Assignee hereby assumes and covenants to perform any and all of the obligations and performance of the tenant under the Lease arising or accruing on and after the Effective Date, including, without limitation, the obligation to pay rent, and agrees to be bound by all of the covenants, agreements, terms, provisions and conditions applicable to the tenant under the Lease arising or accruing from and after the Effective Date. -1- 14005957v.1

5. No Brokers. Assignor and Assignee each represent and warrant to the other that it has not dealtwith anybroker in connectionwith this assignment. 6. Counterparts. The Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed tobe an original and all of which,taken together, shall constitute but one and the same instrument and shall be binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of the respective successors and assigns of the Assignor and Assignee. The exchange of copies of this Agreement and signature pages by facsimile transmission, by electronic mail in portable document format ("PDF") form, or by any other electronic means intended to preserve the original graphic and pictorial appearance of a document,or by combination of such means,shall constitute effective execution and delivery of this Agreement as to the Parties and may be used in lieu of the original Agreementfor all purposes. 7. Effectiveness. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, this Assignment and Assumption shall not become effective and shall not be binding on Assignor andAssignee unless and until theconsent of Landlord heretohasbeen obtained and delivered to Assignor and Assignee. 8. Indemnity. Assignee agrees to defend,indemnify and hold Assignor and its affiliates and their respective trustees, directors, officers, employees, faculty and agents harmless from any Claims arising or accruing under the Lease from and after the Effective Date.Assignor agrees to defend, indemnify and hold Assignee and its affiliates and their respective trustees, directors, officers, employees, meinbers, and agents harmless from and against any Claims arising or accruing under the Lease for any period prior lo the Effective Date. The provisions of this paragraph shall survive the expiration or earlier termination of this Assignment. 9. Miscellaneous.This Agreement is binding on all parties who lawfully succeed to the rights or take the place of theAssignor or Assignee, shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York as applied to contracts executed and entirely performed in such state, sets forth the entire agrecment of the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter hereof, and may not be modified or amended in any manner other than by a written agreement signed by the party to be charged therewith.This instrument and the rights and liabilities contained herein shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and assigns.
